environment.node: lab node with the ATOM build set and RNGD artifacts (96 cores, shared; no NPU used)
environment.store: local fs backend on the same disk; page cache not dropped

inputs.atom-set: Rebellions ATOM Llama-3.1-8B build set, 19 files, 263.9 GB (read-only)
inputs.rngd: four furiosa-llm 2026.3 artifacts pfbatch, preset (params + graphs), coarse, fine (graphs), pushed in that order
inputs.switchlm: decode_S256_B2_lm.rbln then decode_S256_B8_lm.rbln (the B2 -> B8 switch of docs/evaluation.md)

policies.probe: --sub-probe 64:0.1 (experiment, commit ec9bc0f; not in the final PR), --workers 1 (deterministic order)
policies.main: binary built from main 05c9760 with its defaults, --workers 16

method: Each workload pushes into a fresh store per policy (n=1; storage results are deterministic for a given push order). store.* = bytes on disk by object kind (packs, pack indexes, composite tables, lists incl. locators, manifests, config); push.stats.pack_bytes of the second artifact = bytes a node fetches for the switch; diff = onggi diff --json between the two refs. wall_s includes process start and the store size scan is excluded.
